segments: The puzzle-heavy path. Most of the difficulty is remembering the Keeper name and translating it into the correct rune order.
Purple glyph above the Gate Trap / Double Tap side
Shoot the purple glyph above the Gate Trap / Double Tap side with the base bow and collect the broken arrow.
In the Trophy Room / tunnel area, get a melee kill on the glowing purple tile while holding the bow, then activate the Keeper urn that opens.
Search the six fixed skull areas: Mule Kick side, Double Tap side, Samantha’s room, upper Trophy/field window area, teleporter-room sink, and the truck bed at Rocket Test.
Return to the ritual urn, make six crawlers, and feed them into it. Listen carefully when the Keeper speaks its three-word name.
Match each spoken word to the knight statues / symbols and memorize the translated three-symbol sequence.
Kill zombies until the correct three rune/glyph drops appear for the symbols you memorized.
Place / view the three symbols on the floor and shoot them in the translated order. The success cue is the Keeper saying, “That is my name.”
Take the reforged Void arrow, place it into the Void altar, feed zombie souls, insert the base bow, and collect the upgraded Void Bow.
Write the Keeper’s three-word name down immediately.
Do not guess the rune order — a mistake wastes more time than checking the translation.
